description: Unsigned transactions to put USDG and a stock into its farm from the wallet: give usdg or stock (or both) and the other follows the farm's ratio (the feed's price for the first deposit, which sets the farm's price). Approvals of the exact amounts first, then the deposit, simulated from the wallet. Shares are accepted down to slip_bps under the quote.

slip_bps.description: Most the farm may move against the quote, in hundredths of a percent (default 50, 0.5%)

stock.description: Stock to put in (optional if usdg is given), in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

symbol.description: A stock on Borro by its ticker, like NVDA or AAPL (markets lists every one)

usdg.description: USDG to put in (optional if stock is given), in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: farm_deposit
title: Prepare: put money into a farm
